source.notes: ADR-238's compiled predicate list against the alignments display's hand-written read test, the default flag exclusion (unmapped, QC-failed, duplicate) plus a MAPQ floor of 20, over two million BAM-shaped records, arms interleaved in one process, min of 15 rounds, on ada. The first compiler (a closure per flag bit, a coercion per compare, Array.every) measured 5.5x on the laptop; the fused compiler (one mask compare for the flag bits, a typed number bound, an unrolled list, lanes over the record in hand) is the row below. For scale, @gmod/bam 10.0.1 fetches, inflates and decodes a volvox read in 359 ns on ada before any extraction, so the remaining gap is about 0.6% of decode alone. The whole-fetch rows are ADR-240 step 3a's gate (node --experimental-transform-types plugins/alignments/benches/readFilterFetch.bench.ts --rounds=15, measured 2026-10-22): 1000x.shortread.bam chr22_mask:124000-143000 opened afresh each round, 153,677 records, the same four entries per record, on ada; a second run read 129.7 and 127.5 ms. The list costs nothing measurable there, so the worker runs it.

values.arm: 1000x whole fetch, filter loop alone, ada
